analysis:
Both units are head-side excerpts of the test file SSDPrefixCacheTests.swift, reviewed for security-relevant behavior. The visible changes are tests only, with no production code. The file_changes patch shows a refactor of a write-behind test helper (productionWriteBehind and productionQueuedByteCap) and additions around lines 3511-3545 and 3685-3727, which are outside the supplied excerpts.

The visible tests encode the stated T-041 posture:
- Active eviction, TTL sweep and corrupt-block removal no longer rotate the cache epoch (lines 1224-1321). A binding change still wipes the root, rotates the epoch and disowns the superseded cache. The disowned cache refuses per-file removals and reports a nil capability (lines 1323-1366). This matches the T-041 note that the epoch is a routing-evidence generation, not an at-rest purge primitive. KEK wipe and per-file GCM authentication are untouched.
- Reconciliation and TTL sweep drop symlink-replaced indexed files without following them, and the outside file survives (lines 1544-1654). This supports the no-follow I/O mitigations.
- Absent-versus-corrupt classification and crash-mid-removal reconcile from disk on restart (lines 1378-1542).
- Ready-receipt tests confirm no receipt is emitted on a too-short donation, rate limit, immediate eviction, shutdown or post-write corruption. Disk-space reserve tests confirm that the pending donation must fit above the free-space reserve, and that an in-flight close is classified as cache_closed (lines 1739-2203).
- Staging-reservation tests confirm the reservation is released on every path (lines 2283-2413).

No test weakens a control or adds attack surface. Remaining question for integration: the production changes behind these tests (SSDPrefixCache, SSDCacheEpochStore, SSDBlockStore) are not in the supplied units. Whether removing epoch rotation on eviction lets the coordinator route to evicted entries safely, and whether disowned-cache gating is correct, must be verified against those sources. No findings from this test-only excerpt.
